A1.justification: Both complete 11-page PDFs describe the same Double Binary Factorization research. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison support reliable assessment of the text, equations, figures and tables. Both end with references; neither contains an appendix.

before.justification: v1 reports original Llama2-7B and Llama3-8B compression experiments, approximation-error analyses and inference-speed measurements in Section 4, Tables 1–5 and Figures 2–3.

after.justification: v2 retains the original compression, approximation-error and inference-speed results reported in Section 4, Tables 1–5 and Figures 2–3.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same binary matrix factorization, scaling vectors, alternating minimization and ADMM procedure, importance weighting, fine-tuning and nonuniform compression algorithm.

E1.justification: Both use RedPajama for calibration and fine-tuning, and evaluate Wikitext-2, ARC-easy, ARC-challenge, PiQA and Winogrande. The matrix-vector multiplication and LLM decoding test scenarios also remain unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the corresponding experiments: AQLM+PV, QTIP, QuIP#, OneBit and BiLLM in the applicable compression tables; scalar quantization and OneBit in the approximation analyses; and FP16 baselines in the speed comparisons.

E3.justification: The model configurations, 256-sequence calibration sample, fine-tuning budgets, compression settings, evaluation metrics, single nonuniform redistribution round and batch-size-1 timing procedures are unchanged.

E4.justification: Sections 4.2–4.3 retain the same uniform-versus-nonuniform comparison, weight-importance analysis and approximation-error analysis across compression ratios. No ablation, robustness test or case study is added or removed.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests. The statistical and uncertainty-reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 1–5 and Figures 1–3 retain identical results. For example, Table 3 reports Wikitext perplexity 7.39 for both uniform and nonuniform 2-bit DBF+PV, with average zero-shot accuracy 64.98 and 65.42 respectively, in both PDFs.

T1.justification: The factorization definitions, optimization objectives, ADMM updates, importance-scaling equations and channel-pruning score in Section 3 are unchanged. No mathematical assumption, derivation or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about binary compression performance, competitiveness around 2 bits per weight, flexible compression ratios, nonuniform allocation, inference speedups and potential energy savings.

C2.justification: The interpretations and limitations are identical, including uncertainty about DBF's disadvantage at 4 or more bits, difficulties fine-tuning binary matrices, and proposed integration of factorization and pruning with fine-tuning.

D1.justification: The new acknowledgment discloses use of national HPC resources and awarded access to the LEONARDO supercomputer. This is limited additional computing-resource information; the experiment-specific RTX 4090/A100 setup, runtimes, implementation details and code link remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, research positioning and cited works are identical. References move across pages because of the acknowledgment, without additions or removals.

P1.justification: v2 adds an Acknowledgments section between the conclusion and references and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. The remaining wording and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The acknowledgment causes limited text-spacing and reference-flow changes on pages 9–11. All figures, tables, captions and their scientific displays remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 adds funding and computing-resource attribution, but leaves the methods, empirical evidence, claims, limitations and scientific exposition unchanged. The small disclosure addition and resulting reference reflow do not establish a meaningful overall quality difference.
